title: Smaller than we expected.
text: Smaller than we expected.. Not what we expected - much smaller - just hoped for a water kettle with ready hot water, without resorting to an electric one.  This one probably has a special purpose, but it wasn’t what we needed.  Looks like good quality, well-made, and the thermometer is a added plus.  Wish it would work for us.
